description:
What Sightkick does by itself (Settings → Automation), either way. None of it limits what you or the owner do.
action:
- job(job, mode): One job: articles (Sightkick's pages: scheduled plans them on the schedule two weeks ahead and they go live on their day, unscheduled writes them into Unscheduled for you or the owner to give a day), keywords (auto research: auto, manual), improvements (auto, manual, with dead-link fixes), links (Link new pages: auto links each page the day it goes live from up to three related pages, outside the weekly limit; manual lists them on Improvements), outreach (auto sends its pitches, manual waits).
- floor(floor): The lowest Opportunity Sightkick pitches by itself, 20 to 70.
- warmup(on, perWeek?): A young site's pace of new pages: on (perWeek 1 to 7, or left out for the recommended pace) or off.
name: update_jobs
title: Change Sightkick's job settings
